objective_catalog.name: cas27
objective_catalog.note: CAS27 special-materials capital, computed in-package from the radial-build blanket volume since the model migration (2026-08-21). Declared as an objective so generic verification compares it against the oracle's own recompute: on the era route this value was glue-fed to both sides and never independently verified.

objective_catalog.name: beta
objective_catalog.note: Volume-averaged thermal beta computed by 'Volume-Averaged Beta' from the profile referents and magnet__B (WI-030); replaces the retired bound input beta. Compared against the oracle's closed form so a magnet study verifies the physics lever it moves.

objective_catalog.name: magnet_capital
objective_catalog.note: CAS22.1.3 magnet capital. Declared as an objective (Item 6 design D9, 2026-08-21) so generic verification compares it against the oracle: a magnet-technology study moves this channel first, and it was a known coverage gap (ANNEX § Oracle).

ties.note: Magnet coil major radius is the same physical quantity as the plasma major radius. Its suffix is R0, not R, so no suffix scan will ever surface it -- the tie must be declared. Advisory here: a group holding R but not this key earns a tie_candidate warning, never an added key. Since the model migration the plasma major radius is one plant-level entry point (R), not the geom__R / rb__R fan-out.

oracle.note: Package-owned oracle seam. evaluate(point) takes a mapping of qualified entry keys to floats and returns a mapping of qualified channel names to floats; it wraps the independent pure-Python oracle verify_stellaris.py, which is imported and never modified. The module also publishes a fixed-name companion, operand_bindings() -> {constraint_id: {source_name: {kind, key}}}, which says which qualified input key or channel each predicate operand means. A generic verifier requires both and fails closed on anything unresolved: on this package one operand of five constraints resolves to nothing by name at all, so a tool that inferred bindings would compare the wrong number and read as a pass.
